independent_counts.weight_interpretation: Encoded word/node/event weights, not solver CPU, allocation, safe reuse or possible savings.

source_v4_action_whnf_diagnostic.interval_scope: Reported action-to-Either-WHNF intervals, possibly overlapping due to re-entry/shared demand; includes in-interval GC/scheduling. Not exclusive CPU, full result work or additive CLI phase.

reproducibility_boundary: Numeric real TSVs and original input texts are not included. Raw hashes identify privately preserved evidence. Full real fingerprints cannot be recomputed from these aggregates.
